_comment: One Model Context door. All tools are served from the shared Ghostbridge socket; identity is authenticated at the socket (Ghostbridge footprint / WireGuard), not via a menu of HTTP ports.

endpoint.description: Single MCP/gRPC surface — demux by service/method via reflection. Auth at socket connect (x-ghostbridge-footprint / x-ghostbridge-trace-id / x-wireguard-pubkey).

not_doors._comment: These are NOT separate MCP control-plane endpoints. Browser UI is :8080; chatbot loopback is not an external MCP door.

default.description: All MCP clients — one socket, full tool catalog after auth

local_chatbot.description: Chatbot also uses the socket door; lazy meta-tools are a client UX, not a second server
